description: Releases a rollback may return to, and the evidence that they served real work (I8 slice 6). infra/rollout/known-good.py checks a candidate against its own tree (preparation loop, migrations, config names) and this record; a candidate comes from here and its release bundle, never from a backup directory alone (F7: the only install backup on the box holds 27af05a, which cannot complete a job). Append entries; never rewrite one - a release that stops qualifying gets a new entry with known_good false and the reason.

releases.reason: no preparation loop (PREP-WORKER landed after it): accepts video jobs it can never prepare; its own commit says the pilot cannot serve until the loop lands

releases.served: second pilot release, 2026-09-24: W12 smoke 15/15, text and video jobs settled with engine-exact counts; E4B run1/run2; E1B through the public edge
releases.caveat: intake close-on-refusal ReadErrors under an 8-burst (fixed in bda1586); LARGE_BODY_LIMIT=8 is not in its env

schema_proof.result: 4226315: its own tests/d (26 suites, 383 passed, 14 SHAPE cases skipped by name, 5 xfailed) + the result-read probe PASS on 0001-0052, on plain PostgreSQL + shim AND on the Supabase image; migrate.py history check PASS on both (the committed driver at fca3ea3, unchanged; candidate e9e32e0e)
schema_proof.candidate: e9e32e0e (0001-0051 as proven at 0051 by KNOWN-GOOD-REPROOF, 0052 lab-control-2's reject, LOCAL-ONLY until the next R151 window); supersedes the through-0051 proof, rerun whole
schema_proof.shape_added: 0024/0025: 3 browser-path cases (an unverified owner/consumer creating a key in the browser, which 0024 refuses by design; the enumerated browser surface, which 0025 grows) - not the old runtime's SQL; 0026: none (its lease-less put_result is 0014's write, the targets' {job_id, text} call); grants, owners, SECURITY DEFINER and ACLs identical 0025->0026; 0027-0051: none (the Lab's objects are new; none of them redefines a 0001-0026 function, and infrx.feature_flags' name check only widens); the candidate's port registry: 1 rig case (test_pgharness's decoy lint: the old formula puts dlab's decoy 57540 on t2i's ClickHouse port), no SQL; 0052: none (two new functions and their grants; no table, column, constraint or existing function changes)
schema_proof.not_proven: the infrx_runtime login (0023 revokes admit/claim_preparation from it: revert on the target's own env DSN); hosted pre-window rows; a browser key INSERT by an unverified owner (0024 refuses it, whichever backend runs); the targets' lease-less result write stays unfenced on 0026 (R147: F-1 reachable through it until the follow-up migration); the Lab's own paths (0027-0051 are not the old runtime's SQL; a rollback to either target leaves the Lab tables unread and the Lab flags as set); 0052 is the Lab's too (lab_control_reject / lab_control_operator: new, not the old runtime's SQL)
